annotations.title: Find brandable names and domain hacks

description: Brainstorm domain names for an idea, product, or company. Returns brandable names and any domain hacks supplied by the source, with availability and monthly keyword search-volume where available. Cached ideas receive a new availability check. Unknown availability and missing registration quotes are null, never reused from an old search. Use search_domain for a fresh quote or follow the registrar link.

description.description: Optional. A longer description of the business, for more relevant names and better-fitting extensions.

idea.description: The company name, product, or idea to generate domain names for. Example: 'an AI tool that writes SQL'.

purpose.description: Optional. What the domain is for (e.g. 'startup', 'blog', 'portfolio', 'saas'), to steer the style.

tlds.description: Optional. Restrict results to these TLD extensions without the dot (e.g. ['com','ai','io']). Omit to let the finder pick the best-fitting extensions, including domain hacks.

name: find_domains
title: Find brandable names and domain hacks
